title: Playboy Magazine June 1983 Marianne Gravatte Playmate of the Year Stephen King
conditionDescription: Ex-library copy with a library stamp on the front cover; cover creasing and edge wear; back cover top edge ragged and chipped. Poster and centerfold not separately verified.
descriptionText:
Vintage Playboy Magazine, June 1983 issue. Cover price $3.00.

Features:
- Marianne Gravatte, Playmate of the Year - 14 pages plus bonus pull-out poster
- Playboy Interview with Stephen King
- George Burns Remembers
- 20 Questions with Debra Winger
- Extra Innings with Morganna, baseball's kissing bandit
- Behind the scenes with the Pulitzers of Palm Beach
- The return of Nolan Bushnell, the wizard of Atari

Marianne Gravatte cover. The back cover carries a 1983 Michelob ad.

Condition: Acceptable - an ex-library copy with a public library stamp on the front cover. Cover shows creasing and edge wear, and the back cover has a ragged, chipped top edge and corner. Spine intact. The pull-out poster and centerfold have not been separately verified - please ask before buying if that matters to you. Please review the photos - they are of the actual copy you will receive.
